source: Schematic TB-303: nominal component values and the service-manual trims; no recording of a new unit
reference_set: none; component values from the schematic and parts list (TB303_REFERENCE.md), the rest from x0x.json
component_state: new: every part at its nominal value, TM3 trimmed per the service procedure
notes: Every constant the schematic or service manual fixes is set to it: Stinchcombe's full coupling network around the filter (filterCouplingNetwork 1, TB303_REFERENCE.md 11.1, network time constants at the schematic values) with his feedback ceiling k = 18.7 and the resonance held 2 % below self-oscillation (limit 0.98, 12); ladder capacitors at 33/33/33/18 nF (cap scales 1.0) in the circuit orientation (filterLadderTopology 1, TB303_REFERENCE.md 10.3); no high-pass between oscillator and filter (oscCouplingHz at its 1 Hz floor, 7.2); the filter->VCA taps as 100k / 220k with the wiper on the 100k (ratio 2.2, 12) and the post-filter high-pass at that tap's R122 100k x C22 10 nF = 159 Hz (15.4); VCA onset R134 22k x C41 0.1 uF = 2.2 ms (15.1); the Resonance law of the linear VR4a loaded by Q18's ~50k bias (skew -0.865); C13 network 47 / 50 / 100 ms; VEG R123 x C42 = 1.5 s; MEG 68 ms - 1.068 s; accented MEG 68 ms; cutoff trim so the service check rings at ~530 Hz. Kept from the x0x fit because the schematic does not fix them: the A-pot curves of Cutoff, Env Mod and Decay (measured; a real two-segment A pot, not the a = 81 estimate), the Env Mod scale and offset, D24's drop, the ladder drive, the square shape and the VCA timing. Schematic values cost fit score on the two recorded units (they are aged and trimmed differently); that is expected. See docs/CALIBRATION_PARAMETERS.md.
